title: AGI Hits the Market with GPT-6 Astra and 100K Nvidia GPUs
seoTitle: AGI: GPT-6 Astra & 100K Nvidia GPUs Hit the Market
subtitle: Nvidia states that general artificial intelligence is now operating in the real world
excerpt: Nvidia announced that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, trained on over 100,000 Blackwell GPUs, now functions as general artificial intelligence.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Nvidia announced that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, trained on over 100,000 Blackwell GPUs, now functions as general artificial intelligence. The announcement came alongside record revenue growth and plans for an additional 400,000 GPUs in the future.

AGI Hits the Market with GPT-6 Astra

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang posted on X that GPT-6 Astra, trained on over 100,000 Blackwell NVLink72 GPUs, has already achieved general artificial intelligence. He wrote: “GPT-6 Astra, treinado em ~100K+ NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink72. From ChatGPT to o1 to Astra in 4 years. AGI has arrived. Congratulations @OpenAI team. 400K GPUs coming online next.”

Nvidia Reports Record Revenue in Q2

In the second quarter of FY2027, Nvidia reported revenue of 96.22 billion dollars, a 105.8% increase over the same period last year. The Data Center segment grew by 117%, and the unadjusted gross margin increased from 72.5% to 75.0%. The expectation for the third quarter is 108.0 billion dollars.

Blackwell GPU Expansion and AI Demand

Huang emphasized that, despite high demand, the supply of Blackwell GPUs is limited to 70%. He cited the generation of 25 billion dollars per gigawatt of revenue from Blackwell GPUs and a projection of 40 billion dollars per gigawatt for the successor, Vera Rubin. Hyperscaler investment in 2026 and 2027 is expected to reach nearly 800 billion dollars and 1.3 trillion dollars, respectively.

GPT-6 Astra Now Available on GitHub Copilot

OpenAI has made GPT-6 Astra available on the GitHub Copilot platform, where the model is geared towards long-term coding tasks and autonomy. It stands out by planning, validating, and confirming results before completing a task, reducing the number of steps required compared to previous models.

How to Access GPT-6 Astra on Copilot

The model is available for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users. Copilot Enterprise and Business administrators can manage access through the model policy in the settings. GPT-6 Astra is charged based on usage, with prices listed by the provider.

Market Outlook and Investment

With revenue growth and the promise of an additional 400,000 Blackwell GPUs, Nvidia positions itself as a leader in the infrastructure powering general artificial intelligence. The company continues to attract investor attention seeking opportunities in AI technology.

With information from Yahoo Finance, The GitHub Blog.
